The owner's monthly backup email covers every shop in one file.

helpers-with-own-login.name: Helpers with their own login
helpers-with-own-login.summary: He gives up to three helpers their own WhatsApp-code login; a helper sees only a simple screen to add sales, purchases and spending and count the till, never reports, settings or the Advisor, and every change is attributed to them.
helpers-with-own-login.story_hook: A helper at the counter should be able to write sales but not see profit or delete anything.
avoid_words: Three helpers maximum; there are no custom permission levels.
A helper cannot change or remove entries; do not describe helpers as managers.

ca-network.name: CA portal and client link
ca-network.summary: A Chartered Accountant opens a free account and gets a code; clients who register with it appear in the CA's portfolio with score trend, who needs a call, a WhatsApp check-in, an email draft in the CA's voice, monthly report and document uploads, and the CA gets a shareable card.
ca-network.show_note: Founder 14 Oct 2026: gated by account type only (it is live for CAs in India). Show it for CAs in India; never promise commission, ICAI endorsement or buyable paid CA tiers.
ca-network.gate: Account type: this is for accountants (and the owners who register under their code), not for shopkeepers on their own. India only in the app menu. Every CA starts on the free tier: card billing for the paid CA tiers is not live (partners.html lists CA Starter to CA Pro at 1,499 to 9,999 rupees a month but they cannot be bought). A CA sees a client only when linked and the client consented.
ca-network.story_hook: An accountant with many small clients wants one list showing who needs attention first.
avoid_words: Do not promise CAs commission income: payouts wait on the company bank account and commission starts from a client's first renewal.
Do not imply any ICAI endorsement.
Do not say the paid CA tiers can be bought.

invite-a-friend.name: Invite a friend
invite-a-friend.summary: He shares a personal link, the friend's registration is credited to him, and credit from the friend's renewals can be set against his own next renewal.
invite-a-friend.gate: Invite link and credit tracking are built, but credit only arises from payments and paying cannot be completed yet; cash withdrawal is 'once payouts are live' and also waits on the company bank account.
invite-a-friend.story_hook: A friend in the same trade asks how he keeps his accounts and he can send a link in one tap.
avoid_words: Do not promise earnings: the commission is 10 percent of the friend's payments starting from their first renewal and lasting 12 renewals; the first payment earns nothing; a Lifetime purchase pays one commission of about 10 percent.
Payouts are not live yet.
Credit is applied to his own renewal only.

works-in-your-language.name: Works in 25 languages
works-in-your-language.summary: The whole app runs in 25 languages, including right-to-left Arabic and Urdu, and his WhatsApp replies, notes, emails and Advisor answers follow the language he chooses.
works-in-your-language.story_hook: He thinks and counts in Marathi, so the app talks to him in Marathi.
avoid_words: The count is 25 UI languages in the app (25 locale files: English plus 24) and 25 in Translations/ui on the website; features.html, pricing.html and the footers still say '13 languages' (stale, India's 13 only). Use 25.
Translations are machine generated (Gemini via translate-text), not by native translators; do not say professionally translated.
The scheduled WhatsApp templates (nudge, reminders, plan ending) are English only until Meta approves per-language copies.
Voice reading is not confirmed for every language (Assamese flagged in code).

nineteen-countries.name: Works in 19 countries
nineteen-countries.summary: The app and WhatsApp bot use each country's own money, tax word and rates, phone numbers, financial-year start and ways of being paid, for India, Nigeria, the UAE, Kenya, Ghana, the UK, the US, Australia, New Zealand and ten euro countries.
nineteen-countries.story_hook: A shop owner in Lagos or Nairobi sees amounts in naira or shillings and pays by M-Pesa or transfer, not rupees and UPI.
avoid_words: The founder's 'nine countries' is out of date: the country table has 19 (the first wave was 9, then ten euro countries were added). Use 19, but note a real phone proof per country has NOT been done (production test N/T).
Do not say 'launched' or 'available to buy' abroad; payment, refunds and the store listing per country are blocked.
EU and UK legal pages still need the Article 27 representative decision.
Tax rates are the statute-book rates; do not present them as tax advice.

free-month-and-plans.name: Free month and plans
free-month-and-plans.summary: He gets 30 days with everything, then can pick a Monthly, Yearly or Lifetime plan on a Plans screen with restore-purchase, manage-subscription and a refund note; the Lifetime plan leaves out the AI help and the messages sent on his behalf.
free-month-and-plans.gate: Paying cannot be completed yet: Razorpay keys do not exist (waits for the company bank account) and the store products starter_monthly, starter_yearly and lifetime are not created in Play Console, App Store Connect or RevenueCat (blocked, confirmed 29 Sep per memory). The Plans screen itself says 'Paying inside the app is being switched on'.
free-month-and-plans.story_hook: He wants to try everything for a month before deciding whether it is worth paying for.
avoid_words: No 'subscribe now' or 'buy now'; never say where a plan is bought or that anything is 'sold separately' (founder rule).
terms.html still describes two plans, a '10-year plan' and AI help 'sold separately'; it disagrees with the app ('yours for good', three plans). Do not quote the terms page.
Lifetime plan has no Advisor, photo, voice, bank statement reading, daily WhatsApp update or automatic reminders.
After the free month an unpaid account becomes read-only; do not imply data is deleted. Refund promise: full refund within 7 days on the first payment.
India list prices are 299 a month, 2,990 a year, 9,999 once; abroad prices come from the stores.

my-business-details.name: My business details
my-business-details.summary: He keeps his business name, address, opening hours, tax number and UPI ID in one place and they flow into his bills, card and listing.
my-business-details.story_hook: He changed the shop's address and wants every bill and card to show the new one.
avoid_words: The tax-id label follows the country (GSTIN, TIN, VAT number); the UPI line is India only.

change-or-recover-number.name: Change or recover my number
change-or-recover-number.summary: He can move his account to a new WhatsApp number with a code, add a backup email and second number, and if he loses his number recover the account with a code to the second number or email, or ask the team to check.
change-or-recover-number.story_hook: His phone fell in water and the old number is gone, but his book is still there.
avoid_words: With no verified backup the team replies within 72 hours; do not say instant.
The email path needs the email service key; the code shows it as 'not available yet' without it.

sign-in-whatsapp-code.name: Sign in with WhatsApp code
sign-in-whatsapp-code.summary: He enters his WhatsApp number, WhatsApp opens with a ready message to send, and a six-digit code comes back in that chat; there is no password to remember.
sign-in-whatsapp-code.story_hook: He does not want another password; the WhatsApp he already uses is enough.
avoid_words: Do not promise a code that arrives by itself: the direct code message needs Meta's otp_login template, still unapproved, so today he taps send on a prefilled WhatsApp message first.
The SMS backup is not switched on until the SMS service is set up (MSG91 pending).
Codes: 3 per number per 10 minutes, 5 wrong tries delete a code.

report-a-problem.name: Report a problem
report-a-problem.summary: He writes what went wrong in the app or sends 'PROBLEM ...' on WhatsApp, gets a ticket number, and can see the reply in the app within a day.
report-a-problem.story_hook: An entry did not show up and he wants someone to look at it.
avoid_words: 'Within 24 hours' is a stated target, not a guarantee; do not promise 24/7 support.

download-or-delete-my-data.name: Download or delete my data
download-or-delete-my-data.summary: From Account he can download everything the app holds about him as a file, or delete the account and its data for good after two confirmations.
download-or-delete-my-data.story_hook: He wants to leave and take a copy of his book with him.
avoid_words: Deletion is immediate and cannot be undone; a shop owner with several shops must keep or empty the main shop first.
Inactive accounts are purged on a schedule per the privacy page; do not claim data is kept forever.

printable-daily-sheet.name: Printable daily sheet
printable-daily-sheet.summary: He prints a free A5 daily sheet, writes sales, collections and purchases through the day, photographs it at closing and sends it on WhatsApp, where it is read and recorded only after he confirms.
printable-daily-sheet.story_hook: He likes writing on paper and wants the numbers to reach the book without retyping.
avoid_words: The photo read is AI on WhatsApp: limits apply, not on the Lifetime plan, and nothing is saved until he confirms.
Do not say it reads every handwriting.

free-calculators.name: Free profit and cash calculators
free-calculators.summary: Two free web calculators, one for cash flow and one for profit margin, that anyone can use without an account.
free-calculators.story_hook: Someone just curious about his margin can check it in a minute before signing up.
avoid_words: Website only, not in the app.
Generic maths; not advice.

buy-or-sell-a-business.name: Buy or sell a business
buy-or-sell-a-business.summary: A planned marketplace where owners list a business to sell and buyers browse with the health score visible; the page only collects early-access interest.
buy-or-sell-a-business.story_hook: Not available; do not build a story on it.
avoid_words: Do not mention it as a feature: the page is marked 'New - Coming Soon' with a 'Get Early Access' button and has no function behind it.
No 'no brokers' or 'no hidden surprises' claims.
